scope: User selected the previous complete CIFAR-10/PennFudan budgets, not full ImageNet/COCO training
selection: Final epoch, all five fixed seeds, no best-checkpoint or best-seed selection
precision: FP32, both TF32 flags false, deterministic algorithms requested, cuDNN benchmark false
software_scope: Vendor-supported PyTorch stacks differ (NVIDIA 2.8 vs MetaX 2.10); this compares platform stacks, not hardware alone

equivalence.method: paired Student t two one-sided tests (TOST)
equivalence.interpretation: Per-model mean over training seeds on a fixed holdout; inconclusive is not equivalent

resnet18.provenance: Native UP ResNet18, 64px CIFAR-10, 10 classes, random initialization, batch64, SGD0.05

yolov5s.provenance: Native UP YOLOv5-S SiLU, 320px PennFudan, one foreground class, random initialization, batch64, EMA off

detr.provenance: Same external official DETR R50 adapter-v2, person/no-object, pinned COCO weights, backbone LR1e-5 and other LR1e-4; NOT an upstream UP model

vit_b16.provenance: Native UP ViT-B/16, full12blocks/width768 but64px/17tokens, CIFAR-10, random initialization, batch64, AdamW7.5e-4
